comment: Read from src/Tonnet.cpp at commit 71e0bcb, the last commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.0.30. With no note enabled the nearest-note search finds nothing and leaves its result at zero (Tonnet.cpp:55 in basic mode, Tonnet.cpp:88 in page mode), so every output reads C. In Page mode the Transpose knob is repurposed as the page selector (Tonnet.cpp:404) and the transposition is frozen at the value held when the mode was switched (Tonnet.cpp:277), which the panel does not say; the hover text changes to read the page number. The hexagon layout offsets five of the twelve notes down an octave and one up, from the table at Tonnet.cpp:18. The Poly In jack merges its notes into whatever the buttons have on, and the merged set is written into the current bank. The module has no right-click menu of its own, so no panel-colour choice. There is no polyphony anywhere except the Poly In jack: no setChannels call exists in the file.
